name: Cursed Rat
body:
CURSED RAT
CR 1/8

XP 40
NE Diminutive undead
Init +6; darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)
hp 1 (1d8)
Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +2
Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., climb 15 ft.
Melee bite +4 (1 damage)
Space 1 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 15, Con —, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +11, Perception +4, Stealth +10
Languages —
SQ undead traits

ABOUT

Scurrying in relentless swarms from baseboard holes and rotted floor cavities, Cursed Rats are skeletal rodents animated by dark rituals.

They swarm individual targets in waves, biting exposed extremities and climbing clothing to distract spellcasters during dungeon puzzles.
